seeds: I'm Katarzyna Nowak, and I live in Gdańsk with my husband Marek Wiśniewski.
We got married on 12 August 2011 in Sopot.
Our daughter Zofia was born on 3 January 2013, and her little brother Jan on 27 May 2016.
My dad, Andrzej Nowak, is retired; my mum Ewa passed away on 14 February 2020.
Marek's mother, Halina Wiśniewska, looks after the kids on Fridays.
My cousin Piotr Zieliński runs a bakery in Łódź.
Zofia's godmother is my best friend Agnieszka Lis.
Marek and I bought a flat in Gdańsk in 2014.
My grandfather left me a forest plot near Olsztyn when he died in 2009.
I sold our old Skoda to Piotr last spring.

turns: how many children do I have?
